notes: Linux port based on upstream v1.4.1 (juppeee/claude-session-browser). Adds full Linux support: native session resume, working tray icon, single-instance lock, autostart, locale detection, Clawdmeter Bluetooth discovery, and a full rewrite of the Clawd desktop buddy (GTK/Cairo instead of Tk, since Tk has no Linux equivalent to Windows' transparency mechanism) with all the same features -- dragging, hover, frame styles, placement mode. Distributed as an AppImage; see PREREQUISITES.md for the small list of system packages it relies on (GTK3, WebKitGTK, PyGObject, and a few others) rather than bundling everything.
